verdict.rationale: Docs confirm generic Markdown import (auto-creating an Object per file) and a dedicated Obsidian migration flow, but there is no evidence of dedicated Notion, Evernote, or Roam importers. A hands-on community report directly contradicts smooth import, describing importing Logseq/Obsidian markdown as 'painful,' one file at a time, with a confusing zip flow that was 'unusable for backup purposes.' missing for 10: dedicated Notion/Evernote/Roam import support, evidence that links/attachments/structure survive import, independent corroboration of successful bulk import.
